index.why_lead_h2_html: Systems and support for digital work that runs itself—where it should. We put the tools and the rollout behind them so East African teams keep trading while admin catches up—with numbers you can defend to a bank.
index.why_p1_html: Our named stacks—Hresa for busy venues, Imali Cloud for finance and stock, Rainmaker for WhatsApp-led growth, and VUKA for hotels and property—back four practical tracks: show up online, automate chores, market with follow-up, and connect every payment path. Sell results people feel, not “we shipped an app.” See each product.
index.why_p2: From Kigali to Dar teams still juggle weak internet, event-sized rushes, mixed mobile money and bank payouts, and WhatsApp that never sleeps. What we ship has to live in that reality—not in a conference slide.
index.why_p3: Retail, hospitality, clinics, schools, property, social enterprises—wherever money slips through manual steps or buried cash. We map the pain, turn on the right product, connect the moving parts, then help you grow without losing the plot.

The Power of NUTEKH in Action.
index.vuka_p: High-traffic venues in Kigali now run on Nutekh—Hresa guest flow plus ImaliCloud money control—without late-night spreadsheets between guest income, housekeeping, and owner summaries.
index.vuka_col1_p: Spikes during conferences route through orderly ordering, clear kitchen cues, and fast payouts—without the chaos paper brings.
index.vuka_col2_p: Owners see profit as it lands—rooms, food, extras—posted to one ledger without hand-rebuilt reconcile.
index.card1_body_html: Show up online: fast site + verified listings (Google, social)—so buyers and lenders meet a serious business instantly. Often pairs with a 7-day cutover onto Hresa or Imali Cloud when venues or finance chaos need a flagship tool now.
index.card2_body_html: Automate chores + tie payments: replace handwritten loops with invoices that send themselves, stock checks that warn early, payout alerts—and the quiet link between till, MTN/Airtel-style wallets, and the bank feed so totals agree without triple typing.
index.card3_body_html: Marketing that pays for itself: clearer offers, standout creative (still and motion), and WhatsApp chats that chase and qualify prospects while you operate—dashboards optional so expansions inherit the same playbook.

Four focus areas for your team:
Show up · Save time · Win buyers · Tie payments together.
services.tab1_body: Show up the right way: a clear website plus verified profiles on Google and social—so shoppers, guests, lenders, or partners trust you on the first look, not after long email threads.
services.tab2_body: Cut repeat manual chores: invoicing, stock checks, approvals, reminders, and payout alerts happen in software while you stay open for trading—your day doesn’t stop for process theatre.
services.tab3_body: Reach buyers and follow up cleanly: sharper positioning, simple creative, WhatsApp greetings and FAQs, and polite nudges that pass warm prospects to humans—tracked against deposits and collected cash.
services.tab4_body: Payments in one tidy story: sales at the till (or card readers), MTN/Airtel (and similar) taps, and bank deposits stay matched in the background—fewer double entries and one place to settle disputes.
services.pk_launch_p: For teams escaping paper-only or patchwork tools: we turn on Hresa for busy venues—QR ordering, readable kitchen tickets, fast check-out—or ImaliCloud when cash, payroll, and stock belong in one cloud. Configured for East Africa’s mixed mobile money and bank reality.
services.pk_launch_t3: Stays calm in rushes & event peaks
services.pk_launch_price: Pricing: Setup from TZS 1.2M - 3.5M (USD 450 - 1,300), retainers from TZS 180K/month.
services.pk_grow_p: We join WhatsApp lead capture, mobile money, till or accounting exports, and the other apps you already pay for so income, stock, and follow-ups tell the same tale. Your people follow one trail from hello to collected money.
services.pk_grow_price: Pricing: Setup from TZS 4M - 12M (USD 1,500 - 4,500), retainers from TZS 600K/month.
services.pk_scale_p: For several branches or outside backers: dashboards leaders open weekly, tighter spending rules, and reports that mirror how money really moves—month-end stops being rescue missions in Excel.
services.pk_scale_price: Pricing: From TZS 15M (USD 5,500+) once we agree the scorecard.
services.pk_me_p: Rainmaker uses WhatsApp plus light AI to greet people, filter tyre-kickers, and send serious buyers to your staff. We add paid ads only after the free path already shows money collected.

index.why_p1_html: Bidhaa zetu zenye majina—Hresa kwa ukahawa unaochaka, Imali Cloud kwa fedha na hisa, Rainmaker kwa WhatsApp, na VUKA kwa hoteli na mali—hulinda maeneo manne: kuonekana, kupunguza kazi za mkono, kusukuma mauzo pamoja na WhatsApp, na kuunganisha njia zote za kulipia. Uza matokeo, sio tu “tuna app”. Angalia kila bidhaa.
index.why_p2: Kutoka Kigali hadi Dar bado kuna intaneti isiyo imara, misongamano mikubwa, malipo mchanganyiko, na WhatsApp inayotaka jibu 24/7. Kitu tunachosanikisha lazima kiendure hali hii—sio slaidi.

services.pk_grow_price: Bei: Uanzishaji kutoka TZS 4M - 12M (USD 1,500 - 4,500), makubaliano kutoka TZS 600K/kwa mwezi.
services.pk_scale_p: Kwa matawi kadhaa au wadhamini wa nje: dashibodi wazi kila wiki, sheria nzuri za matumizi, na ripoti zinazoelezea njia halisi ya pesa—mwisho wa mwezi si tena kusafisha lahaka kwa haraka.
services.pk_me_p: Rainmaker hutumia WhatsApp na akili nyepesi kusalimu, kusafisha wakora, na kupeleka wateja tayari kwa timu. Matangazo yaliyolipwa yanakuja baada ya njia ya bila malipo kuonyesha pesa imekusanywa.

projects.hero_p_html: Hresa kwa maeneo yenye wateja wengi, Imali Cloud kwa pesa na hisa mahali pamoja, Rainmaker kwa ukuaji WhatsApp, na VUKA kwa hoteli na mali—kwa mstari mmoja wa DEPLOY · INTEGRATE · SCALE.
projects.flagship_h2: Bidhaa nne tunazosanikisha, kufunza, na kusaidia.
projects.flagship_lead: Unapata matokeo wazi—mapato zaidi, upotevu mdogo, kazi za mkono chini—not sogi la “pakua app”. Tunafunga kazi kwa pesa unayoiona.
projects.flagship_cta: Agiza miadi ya dakika 30 ya bila malipo
projects.imali_sub: ImaliCloud · fedha na operesheni mahali pamoja
projects.imali_h3: Fahamu faida wakati mwezi bado haijafunga—si baada ya Excel.
projects.imali_p: Nyumba moja mtandaoni kwa idhini, ununuzi, hisa, ankara na ripoti. Wamiliki na hazina wanaona picha moja hai kwenye matawi.
projects.imali_li1: Matawi yanaunganishwa kwenye daftari moja yenye kuaminika
projects.imali_li2: Ununuzi na hisa kusaidia utabiri kabla mfuko kukauka
projects.imali_li3: Mipango ya uongozi unayoweza kutoa benki au bodi
projects.heba_h3: Agizo linafika jikoni haraka; malipo yanafuatika wazi.
projects.heba_p: Wageni wanatumia QR, tiketi zinaonekana wazi jikoni, na mtiririko wa pesa unabaki mpangilio hata intaneti ikipotea.
projects.heba_li1: Changamoto chache kati ya mgeni, menyu na bili
projects.heba_li2: Jikoni linaona nini kupikwa na kinachohitaji haraka
projects.heba_li3: Imeundwa kwa msongamano na intaneti dhaifu
projects.me_p: Husalamu, huhifadhi, na kumpeleka mnunuzi serious kwa timu—inafungwa kwenye pesa zilizokusanywa, sio idadi ya ujumbe.
projects.me_li1: Majibu ya kiotomatiki na hatua ya mtu halisi ikihitajika
projects.me_li2: Njia za ufuatiliaji zinazoendana na huduma zako
projects.me_li3: Herufi tunazoangalia ni pesa sio kubofya tu
projects.vuka_h3: VUKA — malazi, housekeeping na pesa ndani ya mdundo mmoja.
projects.vuka_p: Huduma za kiwango na mali husimamiwa kwa mtiririko mmoja wa mbele na nyuma kwa hesabu—isiku za kuokoa spreadsheets badala ya kulala.
projects.roll_p: Kila mfuko una siku za wazi, mikakati na mafunzo—ili wafanyakazi halisi na wateja kulipia wakitumia, sio slides.
projects.ph_d1_p: Ona mahali pesa au saa zinapotea, kubaliana mfuko gani wa kwanza.
projects.ph_d2_p: Tunasukuma hatua kwa hatua—njia ya zamani na mpya inaendeshwa pamoja kwa muda mfupi wakati watu wanajifunza.
projects.ph_d3_p: Tunabakia kuboresha mtiririko—hususan mapato kutoka WhatsApp na daftari zinapo passana.
